### Risks

- Root .gitignore and README already have unrelated changes that must be preserved.
- A path default could create provider or model files outside .sys4ai/memory.

### Acceptance criteria

- Canonical files identify sys4ai-depot and a unique dataset and resolve every derived, provider, model, audit, receipt, export, and log path below .sys4ai/memory.
- Ignore and discovery exclusions are present before initialization.
- Loading and preflight are side-effect free and reject symlink, user-home, child-project, and credential-bearing paths.

### Planned verification

- Load the configuration through the provider-neutral loader without importing Cognee.
- Run path, strict-config, secret, and ignore checks.
- Compare root filesystem and user-wide Cognee log baselines before and after preflight.

### Risks

- A generic registration command could become an unreviewed arbitrary-path ingestion interface.
- Removing an exclusion to admit one folder could weaken all projects.

### Acceptance criteria

- An unregistered representative folder remains excluded by default.
- A reviewed canonical registry change containing every required metadata field admits only that eligible folder.
- The same mechanism rejects child-project, derived, cache, environment, secret, temporary, and raw-log paths without code or exclusion changes.
- Eligible future source registration works by reviewed data/configuration changes without adding a second authorization layer or requiring a Memory Service source-code change for each new folder.

### Planned verification

- Run administrative authorization and source-registration tests.
- Exercise before-and-after discovery in a disposable root fixture.
- Verify canonical registry reread and action-specific authorization.

### Risks

- Fixture layouts that omit hidden or ignored paths could miss a real exclusion gap.
- Broad root tests must not ingest live confidential or derived content.

### Acceptance criteria

- Tests cover every required source category and every prohibited path category using bounded fixtures.
- Execution-critical recall is checked against canonical reread, and reusable or evidential memory cannot grant authority.
- No live source ingestion or provider initialization occurs in these focused registry tests.
- All Projects children are excluded, including the unregistered Electronics project and child roots with absent Git markers; exclusion cannot depend solely on registry membership or .git presence.

### Planned verification

- Run root registry tests and relevant Memory Service discovery and authority tests.
- Audit fixture coverage against all REQ-023 named paths.
- Inspect tests for direct live-root ingestion or provider calls.
